name: Pearltrees

sources.title: Pearltrees homepage — 'Create your account', Facebook/X/Google signup, 'It's quick and it's free'
Batched register URL — returns 'Sorry, this page no longer exists'; signup happens from the homepage form

requirements: Pearltrees is a curation platform — the 'listing' is a public collection ('pearltree') containing a pearl (link) to your product
preparation: Product URL and a title/description for the pearl
A themed collection name related to your product's niche
workflow: Create an account from the pearltrees.com homepage form (the /s/register deep link is dead)
Create a collection and add your product URL as a pearl with title/description
Keep the collection public so it appears in Pearltrees' public pages/search
Verify the collection URL renders logged-out
watchFor: The register deep link in the batch (pearltrees.com/s/register) is dead — go through the homepage signup
Premium and Education tiers exist; the free tier is sufficient for a public collection
Low-activity curation platforms provide modest SEO value — don't expect review-queue style exposure
countsAsLive: A public Pearltrees collection containing the product pearl, reachable at its public URL without login
unknowns: Whether public collections are indexed/discoverable without engagement
